commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak 44 reading and benchmark indices trapped beneath falling 20- and 50-day moving averages, the overarching trend dictates defensive capital preservation. Stan Weinstein's stage discipline warns against aggressive buying when the broad tape is under institutional distribution; William O'Neil's market direction framework similarly places equities in an active correction. Even as heavy FII selling encounters domestic institutional support, leadership remains narrow and stock-specific. Under Minervini's progressive exposure rules, cash remains the default posture. New pivot executions must be treated with reduced position sizing, rapid stop enforcement, and strict demand for confirmed CANSLIM earnings acceleration, avoiding laggards experiencing operational margin compression.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAATECH.technical: Clearing 20-session highs on an impressive 10.93x volume surge exhibits short-term demand, with RSI at 64. However, the stock lacks sustained Stage 2 institutional sponsorship, trading within a prolonged cyclical bottoming base without confirmed multimonth relative strength leadership.
AAATECH.fundamental: Fundamentals fall short of CANSLIM standards. Q4 FY26 suffered an operational net loss (-₹0.35 Cr), while sales growth remains sluggish at under 5%. Return metrics are weak (ROE 6.7%, ROCE 9.0%), and working capital stretch offsets the debt-free balance sheet.
AAATECH.risk: Fails if price slips below the 91.81 stop. Immediate exit required on volume distribution below the 20-day average.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a 26.6% deep double-bottom cup-and-handle pattern above rising 50-day and 200-day moving averages, with RSI at 65 reflecting constructive recovery momentum, but broader structural overhead resistance remains heavy.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Poor operational fundamentals disqualify the setup under CANSLIM. Q1 FY27 net sales plunged 56.3% YoY to ₹44.6 Cr while net profit dropped 25.6%. Operating margins remain razor-thin at 1.5% with sub-par 3.4% ROE and negligible institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Pattern breaks down on violation of the 95.61 swing low stop, invalidating the double bottom structure.

ACE.technical: Clean Stage 2 structure holding comfortably above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Cup depth of 12.8% with a tight 4.4% handle reflects healthy VCP characteristics, showing strong relative strength in a leading capital goods sector.
ACE.fundamental: High-quality franchise commanding over 60% domestic mobile crane share. Q1 FY27 delivered record revenue up 19% YoY to ₹836 Cr and PAT growth of 22.5%, complemented by superior capital efficiency (ROCE 31.6%, ROE 22.8%) and a virtually debt-free balance sheet.
ACE.risk: Thesis invalidates if 1189.87 support cracks. Enforce strict stop discipline given adverse general market conditions.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Carving out a double-bottom consolidation above key moving averages with RSI at 61 and MACD trending positively. Base exhibits strong relative strength, holding tight while benchmark indices experience persistent distribution.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM profile. Q1 FY27 revenue rose 63.3% YoY to ₹954 Cr and PAT surged 79.9% to ₹235 Cr behind rapid utility-scale and BESS capacity commissioning. Robust operating margins near 87% offset high leverage typical of utility IPP expansion.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Breakout fails below 436.83 neckline. Cut immediately if high capital expenditure strains liquidity in market downturn.

ADVANCE.technical: Consolidating within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on double normal volume, aligned above rising short- and long-term averages. RSI at 57 indicates steady accumulation without near-term exhaustion.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Powerful CANSLIM growth acceleration. Q1 FY27 net profit jumped 152.2% YoY to ₹22.6 Cr as revenue expanded 95.9% to ₹330.4 Cr, driven by agrochemical technical manufacturing integration. Return ratios remain solid (ROCE 19.6%, ROE 17.2%).
ADVANCE.risk: Violating 130.78 invalidates the pivot. High customer concentration requires strict loss cutting.

AETHER.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout into new 52-week highs on 8.13x volume expansion, confirming massive institutional demand. Perfectly aligned above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and rising 200 SMA with pristine relative strength versus the weak Nifty baseline.
AETHER.fundamental: Outstanding institutional-grade growth. Q1 FY27 PAT rose 33.5% YoY to ₹62.7 Cr on 27% revenue growth, backed by high-margin CRAMS contracts and Dow Chemical R&D partnerships. Operating margins hold strong at 31% with low leverage.
AETHER.risk: Thesis fails if price slips back below the 1596.97 pivot base; execute quick stop to protect capital.
